report.headline: For TAS1 half-hour ending 2026-07-31 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000): forecast POE10 1458.0 MW, POE50 1413.0 MW, POE90 1369.0 MW; actual operational demand 1455.0 MW.
summary: The requested run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202607310530_20260731050135 (issued 2026-07-30T18:56:59Z) gave POE10 = 1458.0 MW [ev0537], POE50 = 1413.0 MW [ev0533], POE90 = 1369.0 MW [ev0538] for target ending 2026-07-31 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
The recorded operational demand for the same interval (interval end 2026-07-31 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 1455.0 MW [ev0534][ev0502].
The compare_forecast_actual pairing reports the actual was 'within POE90-POE10' for this target interval (see the run pairing in the compare_forecast_actual result).
The run-level mean absolute error (MAE) over the compared window is 13.88 MW [ev0605].

possible_explanations.statement: The POE10 and POE90 values might be the AEMO-published scaling of POE50 (AEMO's POE10/POE90 derivation from POE50 is described in forecast metadata).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect the forecast file or procedural note (e.g. SO_OP_3710) and the run's metadata to confirm the scaling method and factors.

possible_explanations.statement: The small difference between POE10 (1458.0 MW) and the recorded actual (1455.0 MW) could be due to normal forecast error or later revisions to the actual measurement.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare initial and updated actuals for the interval and review the forecast error details and revision history for that interval.
